title: Plant Science is Reorganizing Around Climate-Relevant Crops: Evidence from 4.9 Million Publications
description: Dataset and code snapshot for a bibliometric analysis of ~4.9 million plant-science publications (1900-2024). The code snapshot is MIT-licensed. The data files in this record are CC BY 4.0. Large derived binaries that are absent locally are documented as re-derivable from the public OpenAlex and PubMed APIs plus the pinned code (A100 embeddings; workstation CPU for the rest). The raw ~41 GB harvest is not included.
